document.cue: Describe a teacher who helped you a lot in your education.

text: I'd like to talk about my English teacher at school, Mrs Aigerim. She taught me English for three years, from the eighth grade to the tenth grade. She was a young teacher, maybe thirty years old, and she was always smiling. She was very kind to everybody.

At the beginning, my English was really weak and I was afraid to speak in class. She helped me in several ways. First, she gave us interesting tasks, for example we made short videos and played word games. Second, she never laughed at our mistakes. She just said, it's okay, try again. After the lessons she sometimes stayed with me and we practised pronunciation. She also recommended some easy films and songs, so I started to listen to English at home every day. Little by little, I became more confident and my marks got much better. I felt happy in her lessons because the atmosphere was friendly and relaxed, and we often worked in small groups.

I remember her because she changed my attitude to learning. Before her lessons I thought English was only a boring subject, but she showed me that it can be fun and useful. Thanks to her, I decided to study English at university. Now we don't meet often, but I sometimes write her a message on holidays, and she always answers. I'm really grateful to her.

tips.en: First and Second give the story a clear structure.
tips.kk: First және Second әңгімені құрылымды әрі қадағалауға оңай етеді.
tips.ru: First и Second делают рассказ структурным и легким для слежения.
tips.example: First, she gave us interesting tasks

tips.en: Little by little describes gradual change naturally.
tips.kk: Little by little біртіндеп болған өзгерісті жақсы сипаттайды.
tips.ru: Little by little хорошо описывает постепенные изменения.
tips.example: Little by little, I became more confident

tips.en: Mixing past tenses with subordinate clauses shows growing range.
tips.kk: Өткен шақтар мен бағыныңқы сөйлемдердің үйлесімі деңгейдің өскенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Сочетание прошедших времён и придаточных показывает рост уровня.
tips.example: Before her lessons I thought English was only a boring subject, but she showed me that it can be fun and useful

note.en: A strong collocation for personal change.
Introduces the teacher: who she is, what she taught and for how long.
note.kk: Мұғалімді таныстырады: кім екенін, не оқытқанын және қанша уақыт екенін.
note.ru: Представляет учителя: кто это, что преподавала и как долго.

note.en: Shows how she helped, using First, Second and a personal example.
note.kk: Мұғалімнің қалай көмектескенін First, Second тізбегі және жеке мысал арқылы көрсетеді.
note.ru: Показывает, как учитель помогла, через последовательность First, Second и личный пример.

note.en: Explains why she is memorable and ends with gratitude.
note.kk: Бұл мұғалімнің неге есте қалғанын түсіндіріп, алғыспен аяқтайды.
note.ru: Объясняет, почему запомнился этот учитель, и завершает благодарностью.

document.title: A teacher who helped you
bullets: and explain why you remember this teacher.
document.followUp: Are you still in contact with this teacher?
